_about: Config for audit_inheritance.py (resources/Layer Definition of Done.md, section 8). Stacks below each layer are derived from the layout; 'targets' can add extra stacks (bottom to top, with a why) and records decisions for routes that stay open: allow (intended, with why) or todo (awaiting the author). Default-layout names; 'variants' maps them for alternative. Every Always On layer is audited automatically.

decisions.why: Author, 2026-09-30: RTP Double Tap's dpad-mode right pad is its own second-tap selection. A second tap in the north or south region transitions to Circular Scroll; anywhere else leaves the window and stays in mouse mode. It's a deliberate edge case, so no touch bind is added. Base's touch (add RTP: Entry Point) sits under a different source mode here.
